name: To LOVE-Re! ~Rakuin Abduction~
original_name: To LOVEれ! ～烙淫アブダクション～
source:
Princess Lal* is madly in love with Ri*o, who is her unwilling fiance.
But Haru*a Sai*nji is harboring a secret love for Ri*o as well, though she has hidden it deep inside of her.

Can you capture both of their hearts?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044187.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
拉鲁*疯狂爱着不情愿成为自己未婚夫的利*欧。
但春*赛*院也暗恋着利*欧，只是一直把这份感情深藏心底。

你能同时俘获两人的心吗？

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044187.html]DLsite English[/url]）
